name: Obsidian Hart Dragon - Young
description: Young Obsidian Hart is a neutral-leaning firmament intelligent true dragon with black star-speckled scales, antlers, and wing-forelimbs. It seeks to test endurance by taking away comfort and shelter. At this age it is an emerging but formidable predator.

attacks.name: Antler and Talon
attacks.description: The dragon strikes one target within Very Close range with its primary natural weapons.

abilities.name: Relentless (2)
abilities.description: The dragon can be spotlighted up to 2 times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

abilities.name: Hunter’s Darkness
abilities.description: While in darkness made by its breath, the dragon gains +2 Difficulty.

abilities.name: Starless Breath
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to exhale a cone reaching Close range. All enemies in the cone make an Agility Reaction Roll against Difficulty 15. On a failure, take 2d8+4 magic damage and ordinary flames and magical light in the target’s space go out until the dragon’s next spotlight. On a success, take half damage without the additional effect.

abilities.name: Roused Fury
abilities.description: Once per scene, immediately after the dragon marks half its total HP (round up), clear 1 Stress and move up to Close range. This movement does not grant an attack.
